'''2011 Worlds Day 2 PMJ DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[PMJ]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet initials '''PMJ''' only — no full name invented. Deck '''ROPS R Smith Style'''. L32 Death Star II: Throne Room (tight crop; earlier Vader w/ saber reading rejected). L39 Imperial Protocol Officer (sheet Protocols Officer).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
